entities.name: Muhamed Pašalić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhamed Pašalić is a Bosnian professional basketball coach and former player who is the head coach for Bosna of the Bosnian League and the ABA League. As a player, he represented the Bosnia and Herzegovina national team internationally.
